title: AI Document Processing
description: An AI-powered solution for automatically extracting and processing information from business documents.
fullDescription: This proof of concept explores how artificial intelligence can automate document processing workflows. The system extracts structured information from unstructured documents and makes the results available through an API.
benefits: Provides structured data through an API

title: Smart Traffic Analytics
description: A computer vision solution designed to analyze traffic patterns and identify congestion.
fullDescription: This PoC uses computer vision and machine learning to analyze traffic camera footage. The system detects vehicles, estimates traffic density, and identifies congestion patterns.

title: Citizen Service Chatbot
description: An AI chatbot designed to help citizens quickly find information about government services.
fullDescription: This PoC demonstrates an intelligent conversational assistant capable of answering common citizen questions and guiding users toward the appropriate government services.

title: Predictive Maintenance
description: A predictive analytics platform that identifies potential equipment failures before they occur.
fullDescription: The system analyzes historical equipment data and sensor readings to identify patterns associated with equipment failures. Machine learning models are used to predict potential maintenance requirements.

title: Digital Identity Verification
description: A biometric identity verification system for secure digital services.
fullDescription: This PoC investigates biometric verification technologies that can be used to securely authenticate users accessing digital government services.

title: AI Resource Optimizer
description: An AI-based optimization engine for improving allocation of infrastructure resources.
fullDescription: This proof of concept evaluates how machine learning and optimization algorithms can improve the allocation of infrastructure resources based on demand, availability, and operational constraints.
